source.basis: Operator spec page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
CyrusOne's Chandler campus is Arizona's largest disclosed data center by power, at 169 MW across eight buildings.

The campus publishes 169 MW of IT capacity and 2 million square feet of technical space. At 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, that capacity supports roughly 4,200 racks. At 10 kW per rack for inference, it supports roughly 16,900. The rack counts are derived from the published power and space figures, not stated by the operator.

Arizona has 512 MW of published capacity across four disclosed facilities, so Chandler alone is 33 percent of the state's disclosed IT load. The state has 57 mapped facilities, and most do not publish power figures. The disclosed total is therefore a floor, not a measure of the state's actual footprint.

The certifications cover SOC 1 and SOC 2 Type 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, FISMA, ISO 27001, TIA-942, and Green Globes. They show the campus is qualified to host financial, healthcare, and federal workloads. They do not show which tenants are present, and the data names none.

suitability.basis: weighted mean of the published inputs named here, scaled to 100; formula on the methodology page
